---
title: "Future and gated models"
---

Some model classes are deliberately outside the current prerelease support surface.

- Tweedie needs a dedicated CDF and benchmark gate.
- COM-Poisson, Sichel/PIG, Waring, double Poisson, and beta-binomial variants need source, CDF, and R mapping gates.
- Correlated, panel, multilevel, GSEM, and finite-mixture models need a separate residual-policy decision.
- DHARMa-style simulation can be used for sanity checks but does not replace analytic CDF endpoint validation.

Missing future models do not invalidate `qresid` when the package does not claim them as supported.
